data.title: Bußgeldbescheid – fine for mobile phone use while driving (€132.00)
data.summary: The Stadt Musterhomburg (Saar) Ordnungsbehörde (Bußgeldstelle) issued a Bußgeldbescheid against Mattis Musterwadern for using a mobile phone while driving on 16 October 2026, imposing a total of €132.00 (fine, fee and delivery costs) and 1 point in the driving register (Fahreignungsregister). The notice was delivered on 24 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is an official fine (Bußgeldbescheid) from the local traffic authority for handheld phone use while driving, worth €132.00 and 1 point on your driving record. You may decide whether to accept it or file an objection (Einspruch); the app will show you the deadline for that, counted from the delivery date shown on the envelope (24 November 2026). If you do not object, the notice becomes final and you must then pay the €132.00 within two weeks of that point – do not pay it beforehand. If you are unsure whether to object, consider getting advice from a traffic lawyer (Verkehrsrechtsanwalt) before the deadline shown passes.
